# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A pixel-art themed Pomodoro timer built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No external dependencies, works offline.

## Features

- 25-minute work mode and 5-minute break mode
- Big countdown display in MM:SS format
- Start, Pause, and Reset buttons
- Keyboard shortcuts: Space to start/pause, R to reset
- Accessible: labeled controls, focus styles, ARIA attributes
- Responsive layout down to 360px width
- Pixel-art aesthetic with CSS-only borders, shadows, and background pattern

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Use the mode buttons to switch between Work and Break, then press Start. The timer will count down and automatically switch to the other mode when it reaches zero.

## Files

- `index.html` – markup
- `styles.css` – styling
- `script.js` – timer logic
